text:
nina (oncall): noticing high etcd WAL write latency in eu-central-2 (avg commit > 800ms). apiserver 5xx and lots of watch reconnections. GPU onboarding jobs stuck Pending. anyone on this? :eyes:

pm: we kicked a big batch onboarding job around 11:17 which streams artifacts to our object store. could be saturating egress/SNAT and blocking etcd snapshot uploads.

alex: quick dumps i grabbed:
```
# kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l app=etcd -o wide
etcd-euc2-0   1/1 Running   0   22m  10.42.3.4  euc2-a
etcd-euc2-1   1/1 Running   0   22m  10.42.3.5  euc2-b
```
and disk iostat on leader shows 99% util for writes, avg await ~1200ms

cloud-sre-bot: alert: etcd_wal_write_latency > 500ms (euc2) => triggering incident INC-3033

leo: if WAL can't upload snapshots because of SNAT/egress, WAL fd backlog piles up and etcd leader stalls. short term options: (1) pause snapshot uploads, (2) throttle onboarding artifacts, (3) increase SNAT ephemeral ports and disk iops.

nina (oncall): i can throttle the onboarding pipeline and pause artifacts. can someone raise cloud support for SNAT + ephemeral ports?

aplex (typo) alex: raised a ticket with cloud: case 789212, they're seeing SNAT table near limit and reported a brief NAT throttling window at 11:18. requested temp SNAT bump and an iops burst for etcd leader volume.

pm: i'll pause the artifact streamer now.

alex: applying controller-manager concurrency reduction for heavy controllers to reduce watch load:
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system patch deployment kube-controller-manager --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args","value":["--concurrent-deployment-syncs=1","--concurrent-job-syncs=1","--leader-elect=true"]}]'
```

leo: also recommend tightening watch timeout for kube-apiserver clients and enabling read-only follower endpoints for heavy watchers (short term).

nina (oncall): cloud replied: SNAT increase done (x2), they enabled TCP pacing patch, and gave a 3x iops burst for 30m on etcd leader.

infra-bot: note: incident INC-3033 created and linked to cloud-case-789212.

alex: after pausing pipeline and controller throttle, WAL wait dropped to ~150ms and apiserver 502s fell to baseline. GPU pending queue went from ~120 -> ~45 in 10m after adding a small relaxed-taint GPU nodepool.

pm: added nodepool (spot-gpu-euc2c-relaxed) and cordoned a few noisy test nodes. scheduling improved.

leo: next steps (post-incident): (a) add runbook step to pause artifact uploads when etcd_wal_latency > 300ms, (b) permanent SNAT capacity increase for euc2, (c) review snapshot scheduling and consider offloading snapshots to a different AZ, (d) test follower read endpoints for watch-heavy clients.

nina (oncall): agreed. i'll keep monitoring for 20m then close. leaving a remind for not to run large cluster-e2e in euc2 until RFC lands. :thumbsup:
